title: Cantilever bending: Euler--Bernoulli deflection, stress and GCI ladder

gates.quantity: max relative error of the meshed extents L, h
gates.reference: declared L = 10 m, b = 1 m, h = 0.1 m
gates.note: geometry is validated before any field is trusted

gates.quantity: tip deflection of the finest Q8 level
Roache grid-convergence index of the finest triple
observed order of accuracy p from the finest triple
gates.note: Chebyshev-clustered Q8 ladder; p is the empirical value, not a wish

gates.quantity: sigma_xx at the top-half Gauss point nearest mid-span

gates.reference: global equilibrium of the discrete system
gates.note: audit of the linear solve, not of the physics; the 1e-5 band reflects the conditioning of a 100:1 slender system, not a modelling tolerance

gates.quantity: tip deflection of the finest HEX20 3-D level

limitations: plane stress is a 2-D idealisation; plane strain or the anticlastic 3-D state shifts the deflection by O(nu (h/L)^2), i.e. far below the gate
the fully clamped root is a boundary layer; Chebyshev clustering is what keeps the ladder inside the asymptotic range
HEX20 full integration is shear-locking limited at L/h = 100, so the 3-D cross-check is graded at 2 % and its observed order is reported but not gated
small strain, isotropic, linear elasticity only: no prestress, no contact, no follower load, no geometric nonlinearity
